raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This line plot illustrates the loss values over a range of iterations for different models. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", has a linear scale with values ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 and tick labels regularly spaced at intervals of 0.1. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale with values from 0 to 140,000 and tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The plot features six lines, each representing a different model: Vanilla (purple), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue), SepLLM (n=64) (orange), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue). All lines are solid and display a decreasing trend from approximately 3.3 to around 2.65 as the number of iterations increases from 0 to 140,000, with the most significant drop occurring in the first 20,000 iterations.
